Frames the central problem this object addresses: when KnowledgeOS holds evidence for incompatible propositions, the answer must not be "pick the most trustworthy source" — authority, evidential support, reliability, applicability, independence, and epistemic commitment need to be kept as separate dimensions rather than collapsed into one trust score [S0876].
